newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Late buying lifts Belgian stocks to new records.
newsitem.headline: Late buying lifts Belgian stocks to new records.

text.p: Late buying lifted Belgian shares from the doldrums on Monday, helping the the Brussels Stock Exchange's all-share price and return indices rise 0.18 percent to new record highs.
The Bel-20 index of leading bluechips also nudged into positive territory, ending up 0.01 point at 2,142.43 points after spending most of the session in negative territory.
Dealers noted that total volume traded in Belgian shares of 3.4 billion francs, of which 2.4 billion was in Bel-20 issues, was low by recent standards.
The market overall was still looking for direction against an uncertain Wall Street, they said.

But trade in selected issues was animated by news their listings would be upgraded to the Brussels Stock Exchange's continuously traded forward market from March 12, the first day of the next forward account.

Bank holding company Almanij was one of the main beneficiaries, rising 400 francs, or 3.02 percent, to 13,650 francs after earlier setting a new high of 13,800 francs. Dealers said the share was also undervalued on a net asset and price/earnings basis.

Another beneficiary, car distributor D'Ieteren also added 60 francs to 6,470 francs. D'Ieteren car hire unit Avis Europe on Friday gave details of its planned London Stock Exchange listing, which dealers said was another reason for interest in the share.

Among smaller issues being upgraded to Brussels' semi-continuous forward market, temporary employment agency Creyf's rose 95 francs, 3.8 percent, to 2,600 francs and holding company Brederode gained 100 francs, or 2.7 percent, to 3,780 francs after setting a new high midession of 3,800.

Dealers said, however, they were mystified by a late rise in shares in utility holding company Powerfin. Powerfin, which is a candidate to be merged with its controlling shareholder Tractebel surged 200 francs, or 4.00 percent, to 5,200 francs.

"If you take three Powerfin for one Tractebel, which will probably happen,...you get a valuation of 5,030 francs, which was price of weighted average. This heavy buying on the close does not make sense," one trader commented.
The boards of Tractebel and Powerfin are due to meet later this month to decide on whether to merge.
